announcement.quote: As we move closer to the stockholder vote on the proposed reorganization of the First Opportunity Fund, Inc. (the “Fund”), Boulder Total Return Fund, Inc., The Denali Fund Inc., and Boulder Growth & Income Fund, Inc. into a single surviving fund

outcome_evidence.quote: Also, on March 20, 2015, the Fund’s stockholders received common shares of BIF in connection with the Merger.

deals.notes: FOFI traded OTC, not on an exchange, so flagged not a listed pair; the merger itself was completed 2015-03-20 per the N-8F ('the closing date of the Merger'). Shareholder vote date given as November 14, 2014. Also merged into BIF in the same transaction: Boulder Total Return Fund and The Denali Fund (see other deals).
